literal_meaning: ছাদ বা ছপ্পর ভেদ করে (roof piercing through)
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে ছেলে হঠাৎ লটারি জিতে গেল, ছপ্পর ফুঁড়ে ধনী হয়ে উঠল।
আল্লা যখন দেন, তখন ছপ্পর ফুঁড়ে দেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He suddenly won the lottery and became rich beyond expectation.
When God gives, He gives abundantly, piercing through the roof.
history: Derived from the Hindi proverb 'Jab Allah deta hai to chhapar phad ke deta hai', implying divine generosity in abundance.
note: Variants reflect regional differences in roofing materials (thatched vs. tiled roofs).
